data.title: 约尔·福杰 · 午后归档的小小成就
data.description: 午后的市政厅办公室，约尔穿橄榄绿制服外套、白衬衫和同色直裙，坐在档案桌旁。她一手按平打开的文件夹，另一手把最后一张纸对齐放入，确认纸角整齐后微微扬起嘴角。桌边一摞已经整理好的文件夹与窗台绿植映着柔和日光，黑发与金色耳饰轮廓清晰。
data.action: 坐在桌边，一手压住文件夹，另一手将最后一张纸对齐放入。
data.camera: medium shot, three-quarter view, seated environmental portrait
data.promptProse: The final loose sheet slides into an open folder beneath Yor Forger’s hand. At a window-side desk in SPY x FAMILY’s city hall, she holds the folder flat with her other palm and smiles at the neatly aligned corners. An olive uniform blazer, white collared shirt and matching pencil skirt retain her tidy office appearance. Daylight picks out ruby eyes, black hair and gold earrings; completed folders and a potted plant sit nearby. One seated clerk, blank paper, no lettering.
